title: A Strongly Blue-Emitting Heptametallic [DyIII] Centered-Octahedral Single-Molecule Magnet

synthesis.procedure: Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (440 mg, 1 mmol), LH3 (259 mg, 1.0 mmol), aibH (103 mg, 1.0 mmol), and NEt3 (3.0 mmol) were added in MeOH (10 mL). The mixture was transferred to a Teflon-lined autoclave and kept at 120 °C for 14 h. After slow cooling to room temperature, yellow crystals of [DyIII7(OH)2(L')9(aib)]·4MeOH were obtained, collected by filtration, washed with Et2O, and dried in air. L' is the dianion of the Schiff base between naphthalene aldehyde and aibH.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Slow cooling to room temperature gave yellow crystals, which were collected by filtration, washed with Et2O, and dried in air.

properties.summary: Heptanuclear Dy(III) cluster with weak antiferromagnetic interactions (θ = −10.3 K) and frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac signals below ~3 K without peaks, indicating possible SMM behavior. Solid-state blue emission at room temperature with Dy3+ 4F9/2 → 6HJ bands plus additional peaks; ligand absorbances are blue-shifted upon complexation.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: room temperature; dc field 0.1 T (1000 G); 5.0–300 K data set

measurements.name: Weiss constant θ
measurements.conditions: Curie–Weiss fit of high-temperature susceptibility, 50–300 K

measurements.name: out-of-phase ac susceptibility χM″
measurements.value: frequency-dependent signals below ~3 K; no peaks observed
measurements.conditions: polycrystalline sample; 2.0–10 K; zero dc field; 2.5 G ac field oscillating at 50–1500 Hz (plotted at 100–1500 Hz)

measurements.name: UV–vis absorbance maxima of complex 1
measurements.value: 382 and 400 nm (blue-shifted from free-ligand 404 and 428 nm)
measurements.conditions: solid-state UV–vis; compared with free LH3

measurements.name: emission maxima
measurements.conditions: solid-state fluorescence at room temperature; excitation at 310 nm; 467 and 559 nm assigned to 4F9/2 → 6HJ (J = 15/2, 13/2) of Dy3+
